uzo.purpose: Sets running text in the system's type roles: body, caption, kicker, inline code; with max-lines a tooltip shows the text it cuts.

instead.kialo: A text that heads a section is a heading with a level, because a screen reader lists the levels as the table of contents and a bold paragraph is not in it; that is the titolo.
A reference inside running text is a link, because a reader follows it from the sentence; the ligilo inline takes the text's role and breaks with it.
A status in one to three words beside a thing is a badge, because a status is read at a glance and never by colour alone; that is the insigno.

boundary.kialo: Text with its own structure — lists, emphasis, links written as Markdown — is content with a renderer, because every mark in it asks for an Ero of its own: the markdovido, which builds it from the Eroj and lets nothing of the source run.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: A section of a page is its heading and the text under it, because the text is what the heading announces.

with.kialo: A link stands inside the text where the thought needs it, because a reader follows it from the sentence; the ligilo inline takes the role of the text around it.
A badge stands inside the text next to the word it describes, because a status is read at a glance where the sentence names the thing (Nachlese 7 ② B-10: phrasing content).
Code inside a sentence is a teksto with kind code, because it is spoken as code in the line of the text; a paragraph never holds a paragraph.
A text cut after max-lines shows itself whole in a konsileto on hover and on focus, because what is cut must stay readable; the whole text is heard already, so the konsileto says nothing more.

case.de: Der Text leitet einen Abschnitt ein.
Ein Verweis steht im fließenden Text.
case.en: A reference stands inside running text.

case.de: Ein Zustand in ein bis drei Wörtern steht neben einem Ding.
case.en: A state in one to three words stands beside a thing.

case.de: Der Text bringt eigene Gliederung mit, als Markdown geschrieben.
case.en: The text brings structure of its own, written as Markdown.

do.de: Wähle kind nach der Rolle des Textes: Absatz, Bildunterschrift, Dachzeile, Code oder Bezeichnung.
do.en: Choose kind by the role of the text: paragraph, caption, kicker, code or label.

do.de: Nimm tabular für Zahlen, die untereinander stehen sollen.
do.en: Use tabular for figures that should stand below each other.

do.de: Begrenze mit max-lines, wo der Platz knapp ist; der volle Text bleibt hörbar.
do.en: Limit with max-lines where room is tight; the full text stays audible.

dont.de: Mit emphasis einen Zustand ausdrücken; dafür gibt es insigno und avizo.
dont.en: Express a state with emphasis; insigno and avizo are there for that.

dont.de: Einen fetten Absatz als Überschrift ausgeben.
dont.en: Pass off a bold paragraph as a heading.

none.de: Der Text nimmt keine Taste; ist er mit max-lines gekürzt, nimmt er den Fokus und zeigt den ganzen Text in einem Tooltip.
none.en: The text takes no key; when max-lines cuts it, it takes the focus and shows the whole text in a tooltip.
